primary_sources.title: Weidmann, Adjoining a root does not decrease the rank (2005)
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF1, Corollary1 proof: the cabling annulus cuts off a solid torus and gives a cyclic root amalgam. Only the elementary decomposition is imported; the rank theorem is not used. Positive slope, Bezout meridian and preferred longitude are derived in the note.

primary_sources.title: Ito, A Note on Chirally Cosmetic Surgery on Cable Knots
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF5/printed167 re-rendered and visually inspected: cable annulus, exceptional winding, section and regular-fibre slopes. The new root presentation fixes its common companion M,L basis directly, including the positive unknot specialization; a boundary section from the opposite torus is not substituted without conversion. No cosmetic-surgery theorem is used.
